context: Tests the cluster-dependent rules: server-side first, documented fallback, target namespace and version, and missing tools.

checklist.name: Documented fallback
checklist.description: On the connection error, falls back to client-side dry-run and records 'Limited validation (no cluster access)'

checklist.name: Does not overclaim
checklist.description: Does not present the client-side result as proof that admission, RBAC or quota checks pass

checklist.name: Namespace policy caveat
checklist.description: Says that PodSecurity and RBAC behaviour differ by namespace and cannot be confirmed without cluster access

checklist.name: Missing tools
checklist.description: Documents that no policy checker is installed and recommends one

checklist.name: Completes other stages
checklist.description: Still runs the stages that do not need the cluster instead of stopping at the connection error

checklist.name: Stage status table
checklist.description: Marks the skipped or limited stages in the stage status table

checklist.name: No blanket pass
checklist.description: Does not declare the manifest overall valid
